_standard: ISO 14644-1:2015 Table 1 -- airborne particulate cleanliness classes
_formula: Cn = 10^N * (0.1 / D)^2.08, particles per m3 of size >= D micrometres
_validity: The ISO formula is defined for D >= 0.1 um only. Killer particles at 7 nm resolution are ~3.5 nm, far below that bound. particle_manager.py clamps to 0.1 um. This is a real limitation of applying the standard at EUV dimensions and must be stated aloud if a judge asks.
_confidence_note: particles_per_m3 values are the published ISO limits at 0.1 um and carry HIGH confidence. Cost figures elsewhere in this project are MODELED.

cleanroom_costs._note: ISO 3-4 leading-edge fab construction is published at $2,000-3,500 per square foot (S12). That converts to roughly $21,500-37,700 per square metre. The per-class build and operating figures hard-coded in particle_manager.py are MODELED interpolations anchored to that single published range. They are not quoted prices.
